titulo_fr: Les panneaux utiles : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Posters and useful signs: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It recognizes prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public spaces. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It recognizes prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public spaces. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention point: In a signal, the imperative or « interdit » usually expresses a rule; the icon and the place provide context. In this fragment, «sortie» means «output».
